agent_description_zh: 基于新空间经济学理论的AI城市设计智能体，负责百年京张AI创新带城市设计方案的生成、校验和持续迭代。
agent_description_en: An AI urban design agent based on New Spatial Economics theory, responsible for generating, validating, and iterating the Centennial Jing-Zhang AI Innovation Belt urban design proposal.

tools_used.purpose_zh: 政策文献研究、案例分析、理论梳理
tools_used.purpose_en: Policy literature research, case study analysis, theoretical framework development

tools_used.purpose_zh: 生成场地边界、用地布局、道路交通、公共空间等空间数据
tools_used.purpose_en: Generating spatial data including site boundaries, land use layout, roads, and public spaces

tools_used.purpose_zh: 生成分析图、示意图、概念图等视觉成果
tools_used.purpose_en: Generating analytical diagrams, conceptual illustrations, and visual deliverables

tools_used.purpose_zh: 中英文方案双语对照翻译
tools_used.purpose_en: Bilingual Chinese-English translation of proposal content

tools_used.purpose_zh: 产业数据分析、空间指标计算、方案评估
tools_used.purpose_en: Industry data analysis, spatial metrics calculation, proposal evaluation

tools_used.purpose_zh: 生成交互式网页展示方案
tools_used.purpose_en: Generating interactive HTML web pages for proposal presentation

tools_used.purpose_zh: 文件完整性、格式规范、合规性自动校验
tools_used.purpose_en: Automated validation of file completeness, format compliance, and regulatory alignment

ai_generation_scope: 方案文本撰写与结构化组织
空间概念布局与几何数据生成
分析图表与可视化成果
指标体系构建与数据分析
元数据与合规矩阵生成
human_review_scope: 战略定位与政策衔接审核
空间结构与专业合理性审核
关键数据与事实准确性审核
边界条款与合规性审核
方案整体逻辑与创新性审核
review_note: 本方案由AI辅助生成，经人工审核，所有空间边界为概念示意（v5.2优化版）
review_note_en: This proposal is AI-assisted and human-reviewed. All spatial boundaries are conceptual illustrations only (v5.2 optimized).
boundary_disclaimer: 所有空间落地建议均为概念建议、参考方案或可供专业团队深化研究，不替代正式规划，不构成政府审定结论。
boundary_disclaimer_en: All spatial implementation suggestions are conceptual proposals, reference plans, or topics for professional teams to further study. They do not substitute for formal planning or constitute government-approved conclusions.
